# `rank`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
rank()
```

Computes the rank of a value in a group of values. The result is one plus the number
of rows preceding or equal to the current row in the ordering of the partition. The values
will produce gaps in the sequence.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `window_funcs` |
| Kind | window (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments |  |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- rank, example 1
> SELECT a, b, rank(b) OVER (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY b) FROM VALUES ('A1', 2), ('A1', 1), ('A2', 3), ('A1', 1) tab(a, b);
A1 | 1 | 1
A1 | 1 | 1
A1 | 2 | 3
A2 | 3 | 1
```
